summary: Frontend-only verification of rounds-input relocation on /log and Edit Match dialog. All four acceptance criteria pass: (1) Team A/B boxes on /log contain 0 number inputs in their header card, (2) a dedicated score row with data-testid rounds-team-a / rounds-team-b renders BELOW the two team boxes (position check confirmed rounds row top > team box bottom); submitting a 2v2 match posts POST /api/matches -> 200. (3) Edit Match dialog opens via match-edit-<id> pencil, Team A/B h4 blocks contain 0 inline number inputs, dedicated edit-rounds-a / edit-rounds-b inputs are present; PUT /api/matches/<id> returned 200. (4) Regression OK: /matches list rendered previous matches (edit buttons listed), leaderboard page rendered with updated rows after new match (6 rows in active season).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. Caused by the visual-editor instrumentation injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> elements rendered from champions/players lists. Pre-existing, not caused by this change, but worth suppressing for cleaner dev console.

critical_code_review_comments: LogMatch.jsx line 53 and EditMatchDialog.jsx line 45 use strict equality on rounds (teamARounds === teamBRounds) but setState receives Number(e.target.value); fine today but note that if the input is cleared, value becomes NaN and NaN === NaN is false, allowing submission with NaN rounds. Consider validating isNaN as well.
EditMatchDialog imports Save/X icons; renderTeam has no team-size badge like LogMatch — minor inconsistency only.
Both files share nearly identical renderTeam, player/champion fetching, and submit payload shape — candidate for extraction into a shared hook/component (DRY).
seed_data_creation: Created one 2v2 match via /log submission and updated it via Edit dialog as part of the smoke flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All rounds-input relocation acceptance criteria verified. Testids used: rounds-team-a, rounds-team-b, edit-rounds-a, edit-rounds-b, slot-player-{A|B}-{i}, slot-champion-{A|B}-{i}, log-submit, edit-submit, match-edit-<id>, edit-match-dialog, log-match-page.
